target: UTM-bundled QEMU, AArch64 PCI graphical guest, one guest CPU
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-mpradix-current-81eac566.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-source-fast --probe-source-module disk:/Demo/MultiCore/MPRadix.ZC --probe-source tests/compat/MultiCore1Runtime.ZC --probe-source-call MultiCore1RuntimeAcceptance
verified: The bundled MPRadix source ran QuickSort, QuickSortU32, and its one-worker radix stage.
All three printed the same sorted sample bytes.
The cooperative worker regression returned 0x2a after checking Spawn, Yield, result aggregation, and completion.
remaining: The guest runtime exposes one logical CPU. Multi-CPU radix distribution, parallel speedup, and real SMP scheduling remain unverified; keep the multicore demo classified partial until those pass.
scope_note: Current ISO QEMU acceptance for the single-worker fallback only. This does not establish true SMP behavior, live UTM UI behavior, or physical Pi behavior.
